Tesla is inviting select customers to order its driverless Cybercab for personal use at a price of $29,990 [1]. 

* Operating the vehicle requires a mandatory $299 per month Autonomy Subscription [1].
* Vehicle usage is currently restricted by geographic geofences to supported service areas in Texas and Florida [1].
